prompt:
An electric car moves along a level track at a steady speed of 22 m s^-1. The electric motor delivers a steady useful power output of 15.4 kW.
Calculate the magnitude of the total resistive force opposing the motion of the car.
hints: Rearrange P = Fv to make force the subject: F = P / v.
Convert 15.4 kW to 15 400 W before calculating.
solution: F = P / v = 15 400 W / 22 m s^-1 = 700 N. Since speed is constant, the resistive force equals the driving force = 700 N.
teacher_walkthrough: Ensure power is in watts: 15.4 kW = 15 400 W.
